chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Chapter 0250: Nine Lotos Clarifies Her True Heart, Ji Ning's Fame Spreads
chapter_meta_description: Nine Lotos confronts her controlling nature and clarifies her True Heart, while Ji Ning learns of the deadly secret army hunting him. A grand delegation arrives to honor his legendary feat.
og_title: Desolate Era: Nine Lotos's Heartbreak and Rebirth in Chapter 250
og_description: Nine Lotos awakens to her ambition upon hearing of Ji Ning's strength, while Beishan Baiwei reveals a deadly conspiracy from the Xuan Army.
twitter_title: Desolate Era Ch.250: Nine Lotos finally admits the truth to herself!

lore_anchors.definition: A trial formation set up by Ancestor Dongyan that forces a cultivator to confront the truest reflections of their own Dao-heart, serving as a barrier to enlightenment.
A state of supreme self-awareness in Xianxia where a cultivator sheds all delusion to understand their fundamental, untainted will, often a prerequisite for major breakthroughs in Dao comprehension.
An ancient, powerful, and oppressive clan ruling over Shangshui Commandery, known for their military discipline and wealth; Nine Lotos is their chosen heir.

A highly elite, secret cultivation army of the Beishan clan of Anchan, forged in countless life-and-death battles whose bonds of loyalty are absolute, even extending to the protection of their retired members.
True Immortal Cangjiang, one of the three reincarnated Immortals in the Wanxiang level of the Black-White College, notorious for his long periods of solitary training and wandering.
A powerful cultivator who has died and been reborn, retaining the memories and Dao insights of their past life. They are typically far more powerful than ordinary cultivators at the same level.

A pivotal fight in Xianxia where a rising cultivator clashes with an established powerhouse to a close result or retreat, functionally announcing their arrival as a major figure regardless of final outcome.
